obligations.source_text: 장난스러운 플러팅 상호작용: 두 성인의 미완 접근-후퇴 물건 교환, 깨어 있는 대상 시선, 절제된 비대칭 미소, 동일 수신자의 반응을 한 프레임에 시각화한다.

bindings.adult_pair_phrase: the same adult recipient remains identifiable throughout the exchange
bindings.approach_withdrawal_phrase: the initiator moves the offered object toward then slightly away from the same target, with the brass catalog key still visibly suspended between them
bindings.playful_face_phrase: a small asymmetric closed-lip smile with engaged eyes fixed on the same adult recipient
bindings.recipient_response_phrase: the adult recipient pauses and reaches toward that same brass catalog key
